summary: Gold.com, Inc. (formerly A-Mark Precious Metals) filed an 8-K reporting that EVP and CFO Cary Dickson resigned effective September 18, 2026, and that Jill Van, 55, formerly EVP, Controller and Assistant Secretary, was appointed CFO effective the same date, assuming principal financial and accounting officer duties. Van's employment agreement runs September 18, 2026 through June 30, 2029, with $500,000 annual base salary, a 50%-of-salary target bonus, and a $500,000 RSU grant vesting in equal parts on June 30, 2027, 2028 and 2029. No arrangements, family relationships or related-party transactions were disclosed. Watch for any 10-Q/10-K filing delays, restatement or control-disclosure signals given the abrupt CFO transition.
